mapper.select: SELECT p.table_name, p.partition_name, p.partition_expression, p.partition_description, p.table_rows, p.data_length, p.index_length, p.create_time FROM information_schema.partitions p WHERE p.table_schema = DATABASE() AND p.table_name = #{tableName} AND p.partition_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.partition_ordinal_position

SELECT partition_name, partition_description, table_rows, ROUND((data_length + index_length) / 1024 / 1024, 2) as partition_size_mb, ROUND(data_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) as data_size_mb, ROUND(index_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) as index_size_mb, create_time, update_time, check_time FROM information_schema.partitions WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = #{tableName} AND partition_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY partition_ordinal_position DESC

SELECT DISTINCT partition_name, partition_method, partition_expression, subpartition_method, subpartition_expression FROM information_schema.partitions WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = #{tableName} AND partition_name IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
